alert_news.title: ToneTag Launches India's First In-Car Fuel Payments on TATA.CARS via UPI Circle & IndianOil
bullets: India’s first in‑car fuel payment solution using NPCI’s UPI Circle, launched by ToneTag with TATA.CARS and IndianOil.
Enables secure, contactless fuel payments directly from the vehicle interface, eliminating the need for a mobile app or card, and integrates with IndianOil’s XTRAREWARDS loyalty program.

alert_news.title: India’s First Flight Acceptance Test of CE20 Engine at 220 kN
bullets: India’s first flight‑acceptance hot test of the CE20 cryogenic engine at uprated thrust of 220 kN conducted at ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri.
The CE20 powers the upper cryogenic stage of the LVM3 launch vehicle, boosting payload capacity for Gaganyaan missions.
The test marks a key step toward operationalizing the uprated C32 stage for upcoming LVM3 missions.

alert_news.title: Tata Steel deploys India's first coke oven gas injection technology at Odisha unit
bullets: India’s first coke oven gas injection technology in a blast furnace, commissioned at Tata Steel’s Meramandali plant in Odisha, replacing fossil fuel as a reductant.
The technology, implemented with partners Paul Wurth‑SMS and Kobelco, reduces CO₂ emissions and supports Tata Steel’s Net Zero by 2045 target.

alert_news.title: TCS Launches India's First Lights-Out Factory Lab in Pune for AI-Powered Manufacturing
bullets: India’s first lights‑out factory lab, a fully automated AI‑powered manufacturing facility, opened at TCS’s Sahyadri Park campus in Pune.
The lab houses a fully robotic battery‑pack assembly line and integrates digital twins, industrial AI, and real‑time operational intelligence to prototype and validate autonomous production systems.

alert_news.title: ISRO Tests Uprated CE20 Engine, Boosting LVM3 Payload Capacity
bullets: First flight‑acceptance hot test of the CE20 cryogenic engine at 220 kN thrust, conducted at the ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu
165‑second test validates the uprated C32 upper stage for LVM3, enabling a 22‑tonne thrust capability and increased payload for future missions
